headline: Give each tip a saved acknowledgement
image_alt_text: Light-mode social graphic titled "Give each tip a saved acknowledgement" beside a desktop screenshot of Hush Line Settings. Message Statuses is selected. The Waiting section shows a Status Text field containing a receipt note and an Update Reply Text button.
rationale: The required screenshot is a cooldown fallback, so this post uses a distinct feature-benefit angle: a saved Waiting status reduces repeated first-response writing for recipient teams. It avoids the archived themes of setting reply expectations, simplifying language, and keeping time promises current. The hook begins with shared-inbox responsibility, and the CTA names the visible Update Reply Text action.

social.bluesky: A personal answer may take time, but each tip can still be acknowledged. Hush Line’s Waiting status gives the sender a saved note while staff begin reading. Use Update Reply Text to set the acknowledgement your recipient team wants ready from the start.
social.linkedin:
Acknowledging a tip should not depend on who is watching the inbox at that moment.

In Hush Line, recipients can save the note attached to the Waiting status. When a submission arrives, the sender gets a temporary address where that note appears. A newsroom, law office, school, or community group can confirm receipt while staff begin reading, without drafting the same first response every time.

Open Message Statuses, choose the acknowledgement your team needs, and save it with Update Reply Text.
social.mastodon:
A newsroom or law office may not be able to answer every tip immediately. Hush Line’s Waiting status can still acknowledge receipt.

Recipients save one note, and the sender sees it at the temporary address connected to the submission. Staff can begin reading without writing the same first response each time.

Use Update Reply Text to set the acknowledgement your team wants ready from the start.

subtext: The Waiting status confirms receipt while recipient teams begin reading, without someone writing the same first note every time.
copy_brief: Write for recipients and staff using Hush Line day to day, not for platform admins.
